tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. A near-neutral with a faint violet bias, so the eye rests and purple only shows where it means something.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, table headers, nested panels, menus.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Use instead of shadows where you can.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary-button borders. moon-500 in both themes: 4.4:1 on surface light, 4.1:1 dark (needs 3:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 16:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, placeholder-adjacent copy (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The product's action color: buttons, links, active nav, checkboxes. Each product points this at ONE accent-* token (default accent-violet). Never for large backgrounds.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary. Points at the same accent as primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text/icons on a primary fill. White in light, night in dark; passes 5:1+ with every accent.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav pill, tags. Points at the same accent as primary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset. Stays violet in every product, a quiet Nanashi signature.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star Gold. The shine. Stars in the logo, one highlight badge, a progress spark. Fill only, and only on indigo, night or as a badge fill: gold on white is 1.5:1. Keep to about 5% of any screen.

tokens.name: star-text
tokens.usage: Gold used as text or icon on the page background (5:1 light).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons, badges. Mint #3EB489 kept for dark; deepened for light so it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings. Deliberately orange, not gold, so a warning is never mistaken for the brand star.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, links inside info banners.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Nanashi Violet. The house accent. Default for the portfolio site and any product that should feel most "Nanashi".

tokens.name: accent-orbit
tokens.usage: Orbit Indigo. Calm, trustworthy blue-indigo. Productivity, SaaS, admin tools. Stays close to the brand without being purple. If used, switch info to violet.

tokens.name: accent-comet
tokens.usage: Comet Teal. Fresh, technical. Dev tools, data, health. Pairs well with gold stars. Success is also green, so always show success with an icon.

tokens.name: accent-tide
tokens.usage: Tide Blue. Clear ocean blue. Booking, travel, education, finance. If used, switch info to violet.

tokens.name: accent-nova
tokens.usage: Nova Rose. Warm, playful, consumer. Food, lifestyle, social. Close to danger red, so always pair errors with an icon.

tokens.name: brand-indigo
tokens.usage: Nanashi Indigo, the logo color. Studio brand only: logo, portfolio hero, splash, proposals. Inside products only in the "A Nanashi project" signature.

tokens.name: logo-mark
tokens.usage: Logo body fill. Indigo in BOTH themes so the gold stars keep 8.4:1. Gold on a lighter violet drops to 2:1 and the shine disappears. On dark grounds add logo-keyline.

tokens.name: logo-keyline
tokens.usage: 1px outline (or tile edge) around the logo on dark grounds, where indigo alone is 1.4:1 against night. In light it equals the mark, so it disappears.

tokens.name: star-white
tokens.usage: Nebula White. Secondary stars and text on brand-indigo (12:1).

tokens.name: star-silver
tokens.usage: Silver Mist. Faint background stars on indigo or night surfaces.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Night sky. Dark brand surfaces in either theme (footer, splash).

tokens.name: moon-0
tokens.usage: Moon neutral scale, cool gray with a slight violet bias. The base of every screen.
